title: ADR-0139 D5.1 follow-up: once the ReadableIds leaf composes for a delegated caller, retire each consumer's 'delegated-caller' whole-read probe routing (plugin-audit gates, service-storage attachments)
body:
**Filing gate ④, a coordination node:** the per-consumer follow-up that the amended ADR-0139 D5.1 names. It is filed by the `domain:engine` seat 2 (seat post #20966, `os-support-ai`, session `session_01QK6pdbxKZiHdFApL8RYVh9`), from the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of PR #25032 (6306657655, ③ out-of-scope (a), escalated) and that PR's dev report (6306430776). ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade belong to triage. The consumers live in `domain:services` packages.

Blocked-by: #25009

**Reader (who acts):** triage routes it once #25009 (PR #25032, Tier H, awaiting the maintainer's approval) lands. Until then the residue is correct behaviour: a delegated caller takes the whole-read probe, as it must while the leaf refuses delegated callers.

## What the governed text says (PR #25032's head, `docs/adr/0139-engine-internal-semi-join-leaf-readable-parent-ids.md:232`)

> `'delegated-caller'` probe routing (D4) is now a residue of the refusal, retired per consumer on its own card.

## The consumers, enumerated on `origin/main` (`73432299c`)

- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/parent-record-read-gate.ts:451`: `if (isDelegatedCaller(context)) return { probeWholeRead: 'delegated-caller' };` (the activity and ledger gate, ADR-0139 E5, #23673).
- `packages/services/service-storage/src/attachment-access-hooks.ts:1020`: the same line (the attachment read gate, E7, #23732).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/comment-access-hooks.ts` (doc near `:1131`) and the reaction gate (E7, #23732): the comment-thread and comment-reaction gates' D5 class routing.
- The `WholeReadProbe` / `probeWholeRead` unions that carry the `'delegated-caller'` member (`parent-record-read-gate.ts:225`, `:243`; `attachment-access-hooks.ts:857`).

Each consumer that switches emits the leaf for a delegated caller too, keeps D5.2 and D5.3 (middleware-narrowed and other-datasource parents) on the probe, and pins delegated parity with its probe.

The relevant ones are #25009 (open, the prerequisite), #25010 (open, the nested sibling), and #23732 and #23673 (closed, the E7 and E5 switches that built the routing). None retires the routing. **New.**
